Name: House of the Oracle
Author: AshesForAshe
Description:
This mod changes the look of the Farmhouse and the Greenhouse and was made to complement The Oracle Forest Farm.

The changes make the basic farmhouse look more damages and overgrown, as well as a tad darker.
The 1st upgrade looks a bit darker as well and is decorated with pots, plants and other decors.
The 2nd upgrade changes the wood look to bricks because I thought it'd look more sturdy given it's the last upgrade.
The Greenhouse is slightly color edited as well but I didn't change much to its design.

See images attached for the look of the buildings.

Downloads.Description: Changes the farmhouse sprite to a more witchy aesthetic.
